name: astril - Run from NIfTI (face-free test data only)
desc: TEST DATA ONLY: input is pre-skull-strip (DICOM headers, faces) and real patient data here is PHI. Co-registers, skull-strips (HD-BET) and normalizes a NIfTI library, then segments and quantifies. Writes the face-free upload set 02-preprocess/upload_preprocessed/. For real patients run this stage locally instead. Versions: astril-nf 0.1.0, astril 0.7.30.
fileRequirementsMessage: PHI WARNING: upload only de-identified, face-free TEST data here. Real patient DICOM or NIfTI contains PHI (headers, identifiable faces) and must not be uploaded to Cirro; run those stages locally and upload 02-preprocess/upload_preprocessed/ instead. Direct upload layout: {patient}/{exam}/*.nii.gz (+ .json sidecars) with patient folders at the top level.
